modules.title: First Steps
modules.summary: Run your first program, read your first error, and stop being afraid of the terminal.

lessons.title: Your First Program
lessons.goal: Make a computer print words on a screen.

lessons.title: Reading an Error
lessons.goal: Treat an error message as directions rather than as failure.

lessons.title: Printing More Than One Thing
lessons.goal: Build up output from several pieces and control where the lines break.

lessons.title: Notes to Yourself
lessons.goal: Leave notes in code that Python ignores and people read.

modules.title: Values and Names
modules.summary: Store things, do arithmetic on them, and build sentences out of them.

lessons.title: Giving Things Names
lessons.goal: Store a value under a name and use it later.

lessons.title: Arithmetic
lessons.goal: Do sums, and know which kind of number you get back.

lessons.title: Working with Text
lessons.goal: Join text together, measure it, and change its case.

lessons.title: Sentences with Values In
lessons.goal: Drop values straight into text with an f-string.

lessons.title: Asking a Question
lessons.goal: Read something the person running your program typed, and turn it into a number.

modules.title: Making Decisions
modules.summary: Let a program take one path or another depending on what is true.

lessons.title: True and False
lessons.goal: Write a comparison and read the answer.

lessons.title: If
lessons.goal: Run some lines only when a condition holds.

lessons.title: Else and Elif
lessons.goal: Choose between two paths, or among many.

lessons.title: And, Or, Not
lessons.goal: Combine several conditions into one.

lessons.title: Putting Decisions Together
lessons.goal: Write a small program that reads input and branches on it.

modules.title: Repeating Yourself
modules.summary: Loops - the thing computers are genuinely better at than people.

lessons.title: Doing Something Ten Times
lessons.goal: Repeat a block of code a fixed number of times.

lessons.title: Building Up an Answer
lessons.goal: Carry a running total through a loop.

lessons.title: Looping Until Something Changes
lessons.goal: Use a while loop when you do not know how many times to go round.

lessons.title: Leaving Early
lessons.goal: Stop a loop, or skip one turn of it.

lessons.title: Loops Inside Loops
lessons.goal: Use one loop inside another to work through a grid.

modules.title: Functions
modules.summary: Name a piece of work once, then use it as often as you like.

lessons.title: Making Your Own
lessons.goal: Define a function and call it.

lessons.title: Passing Things In
lessons.goal: Write a function that behaves differently depending on what it is given.

lessons.title: Handing an Answer Back
lessons.goal: Return a value from a function instead of printing it.

lessons.title: Optional Arguments
lessons.goal: Give a parameter a default, and pass arguments by name.

lessons.title: What a Function Can See
lessons.goal: Understand which variables exist where, and document what a function does.

modules.title: Lists
modules.summary: Hold many values under one name, and do something to each of them.

lessons.title: Many Things, One Name
lessons.goal: Create a list and read items out of it by position.

lessons.title: Looping Over a List
lessons.goal: Do something to every item in a list.

lessons.title: Changing a List
lessons.goal: Add, remove, sort and search a list.

lessons.title: Building Lists in One Line
lessons.goal: Write a list comprehension, and know when not to.

lessons.title: A Small Report
lessons.goal: Combine loops, lists and functions into something useful.

modules.title: Dictionaries and Sets
modules.summary: Look things up by name instead of by position, and keep a collection unique.

lessons.title: Looking Things Up
lessons.goal: Store pairs of keys and values, and get a value back by its key.

lessons.title: Going Through a Dictionary
lessons.goal: Loop over pairs, and count things with a dictionary.

lessons.title: Sets and Tuples
lessons.goal: Use a set to remove duplicates and a tuple to fix a group of values.

lessons.title: Data Inside Data
lessons.goal: Work with a list of dictionaries, which is how most real data arrives.

modules.title: Text
modules.summary: Take text apart, put it back together, and clean up what people typed.

lessons.title: Splitting and Joining
lessons.goal: Turn text into a list and a list back into text.

lessons.title: Asking Questions About Text
lessons.goal: Test what a string contains, and slice pieces out of it.

lessons.title: Cleaning Up Real Input
lessons.goal: Normalise messy text so that comparisons work.

modules.title: When Things Go Wrong
modules.summary: Handle the errors you can predict, and raise your own for the ones you cannot fix.

lessons.title: Catching an Error
lessons.goal: Keep a program running when something predictable goes wrong.

lessons.title: Raising Your Own
lessons.goal: Reject bad input at the door instead of letting it spread.

lessons.title: Reading and Writing Files
lessons.goal: Save something to disk and read it back.

modules.title: Build Something
modules.summary: Four projects that use everything, with far less hand-holding.

lessons.title: FizzBuzz
lessons.goal: Write the exercise every programmer has been asked at an interview.

lessons.title: A Guessing Game
lessons.goal: Build a loop that keeps asking until the answer is right.

lessons.title: A Grade Book
lessons.goal: Turn a pile of records into a report, using functions to keep it readable.

lessons.title: A To-Do List That Remembers
lessons.goal: Build a complete program - data, functions, files and error handling together.

modules.title: Objects of Your Own
modules.summary: Build your own types when a dictionary stops being enough.

lessons.title: Your First Class
lessons.goal: Define a type, and create instances of it.

lessons.title: Making an Object Printable
lessons.goal: Control how your object appears, and how it compares.

lessons.title: Building on a Class
lessons.goal: Extend a class instead of copying it.

lessons.title: Classes Without the Boilerplate
lessons.goal: Use a dataclass when the class is mostly fields.

lessons.title: When Not to Write a Class
lessons.goal: Recognise the cases where a function is the better answer.

modules.title: Standing on Others' Work
modules.summary: Import the library that already solved your problem.

lessons.title: Importing
lessons.goal: Bring in code from outside your file, three different ways.

lessons.title: Tools for Counting
lessons.goal: Replace hand-written counting loops with the collections module.

lessons.title: Saving Structured Data
lessons.goal: Write dictionaries and lists to a file and read them back unchanged.

lessons.title: Dates and Times
lessons.goal: Do arithmetic on dates without counting days yourself.

modules.title: Thinking in Algorithms
modules.summary: Solve the same problem two ways and measure which one holds up.

lessons.title: Functions That Call Themselves
lessons.goal: Write a recursive function with a base case that stops it.

lessons.title: Two Ways to Find Something
lessons.goal: Write binary search, and understand why it beats scanning.

lessons.title: Sorting
lessons.goal: Write a sort by hand, then use the one that ships with Python.

lessons.title: Picking the Right Container
lessons.goal: Choose between a list, a set and a dictionary by how it will be used.

modules.title: A Real Project
modules.summary: Build one program across four lessons, the way software actually gets written.

lessons.title: The Data Model
lessons.goal: Design the shape of the data before writing anything that uses it.

lessons.title: The Operations
lessons.goal: Write the functions that change and query a list of tasks.

lessons.title: Making It Survive
lessons.goal: Save the tasks to disk and load them back, including the parts JSON cannot hold.

lessons.title: The Interface
lessons.goal: Put a command interface on the program and finish it.
